title: Sushi
description: A short sushi prep clip — first 20 seconds.

title: POV Copper Plumbing
description: First-person copper pipework, measuring, fitting, and wall preparation.

title: POV First PC Build (novice)
description: Head-cam POV of a first-time PC builder mid-build: motherboard in its wrap next to loose accessory bags, an AIO liquid-cooler radiator with twin fans, a tangle of unrouted fan cables, and a bracket being fitted into the case. The builder is a novice — sloppy, ESD-risky handling and mistakes are present and uncorrected.

title: POV PC Build Guide — CPU & RAM
description: First-person build-guide footage: unboxing an Intel Core i5-12600KF, seating the CPU in the motherboard socket, closing the retention arm, then clipping G.Skill Ripjaws V DDR4 sticks into the DIMM slots. Deliberate, correct step-by-step technique throughout.

title: POV PC Build Guide — GPU
description: First-person build-guide footage: unboxing an XFX Radeon graphics card, removing PCIe slot covers on a white case, seating the card in the PCIe x16 slot, and connecting the power cable. Deliberate, correct step-by-step technique.

title: POV Tuna Melt
description: Overhead head-cam POV of making a tuna melt in a home kitchen: opening a tuna can over a wooden cutting board, chopping celery, mixing in mayonnaise, assembling the sandwich, and frying it in a skillet on the stove.
